mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as measured by the current rate level.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of months when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to recession fears.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.3pp in 3 months over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in unemployment rate signals deepening economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through dual-sector deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO falls >0.5% and UNRATE rises >0.3pp in the same month over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles defined by rising federal funds rate produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as higher rates pressure equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of months during FEDFUNDS rising periods (by >0.25pp in 3 months) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts indicate robust consumer demand and economic activity, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through demand-driven corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of months when HOUST exceeds 1600 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation signaled by CPIAUCSL rising above 2.0 points in 3 months triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to anticipated Fed tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises >2.0 points in 3 months over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint growth in payrolls and retail sales signals strong labor market and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through synchronized demand expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when PAYEMS rises >50k and RSAFS rises >0.5% in the same month over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion regime defined by high GDP growth and low unemployment produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to valuation compression and policy tightening expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of months when GDPC1 annualized growth >3% and UNRATE <4.5% over a 3-year rolling window.
